title: MCP Gateways and Registries — Enterprise Control Planes

questions.question: Your company approves a few external data connectors, but every developer installs them directly in their own editor with their own credentials. What is the risk?
options: The connectors run faster without a middleman
Developers learn more about the connectors
Nothing; direct installation scales well
No central control over who may access what, and no audit trail
questions.explanation: Direct installation means per-developer credentials and invisible usage. This lesson builds the gateway that restores central auth, scoping, and audit.

questions.question: What does the TokenBucket's initial capacity of five permit before refill is considered?
options: All calls in the burst, regardless of count
Only one call per second
No calls until a token is externally granted
Five immediate calls can consume the initial tokens
questions.explanation: The bucket starts with five tokens and refills at one token per second; an immediate burst can therefore consume five before rate limiting.

questions.question: What happens when Bob calls github.open_pr?
options: HTTP-style 403 plus a forbidden audit entry
The gateway grants a temporary developer role
It routes to notes.create
It returns 429 before checking authorization
questions.explanation: Bob's RBAC entry includes GitHub list_issues but not open_pr, so the call is denied with 403 and audited as forbidden.

questions.question: What does the gateway do after notes.search's description changes from its pinned hash?
options: It updates the manifest automatically
tools/list drops it; call returns 409 hash_mismatch
It keeps the tool visible but ignores calls
It changes the tool's canonical name
questions.explanation: The registry verifies the pinned description hash; a mismatch removes the tool from discovery and returns conflict 409 on invocation.

questions.question: What status does gateway_tools_call return for an invalid bearer token?
questions.explanation: Authentication is checked before RBAC, rate limits, or manifest lookup, so an unknown bearer receives HTTP-style status 401.

questions.question: Which canonical name identifies the GitHub pull-request tool?
options: open_pr.github
notes.open_pr
github/list_issues
github.open_pr
questions.explanation: The gateway namespaces the backend name with the server prefix, yielding github.open_pr for the pull-request operation.
